title: Why Wind Makes You Freeze at the Same Temperature
caption:
Same air, same cold - so why does wind make it worse?
A cartoon guy laughs off a freezing winter day, then ends up shivering inside a block of ice.
Wind doesn't lower the air temperature - it strips away the warm air layer around your body, so you lose heat faster.
How much colder does the wind make it feel where you live?
Save this for the next windy day and share it with a friend who skips the windbreaker.
